note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, or release.

gates.title: Gate V12-G1 — Gate, Release, and Acceptance-Evidence Governance Foundation Ready
gates.escalation_path: Escalates unmet conditions to the Executive Sponsor for disposition.

criteria.title: Evidence-intake decision
criteria.permitted_disposition: Admit, reject, or return for provenance.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Intake is not validity and is not sufficiency.
criteria.escalation_path: Escalates to the Release Governance Authority.

criteria.title: Evidence-validity decision
criteria.prohibited_inference: Validity is not sufficiency and is not acceptance.
criteria.escalation_path: Escalates to the Independent Assurance Authority.

criteria.title: Evidence-sufficiency decision
criteria.prohibited_inference: Sufficiency for one object is not system-wide conformance.
criteria.escalation_path: Escalates to the Release Governance Authority.

criteria.title: Domain-acceptance decision
criteria.permitted_disposition: Accept, reject, or accept with conditions.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Domain acceptance is not business acceptance.
criteria.escalation_path: Escalates to the Business Owner Authority.

criteria.title: Operational-acceptance decision
criteria.permitted_disposition: Accept, reject, or accept with conditions.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Operational acceptance is not release authorization.
criteria.escalation_path: Escalates to the Release Governance Authority.

criteria.title: Business-acceptance decision
criteria.permitted_disposition: Accept, reject, or accept with conditions.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Business acceptance is not operational acceptance.

criteria.title: Independent-assurance conclusion
criteria.required_independence: Independent of owner, executor, and acceptance authority.
criteria.prohibited_inference: An assurance conclusion is not a substitute for evidence.

criteria.title: Material-commitment decision
criteria.permitted_disposition: Approve with expiry, reject, or defer.
criteria.prohibited_inference: A waiver is not a failure converted to success.

criteria.title: Release-gate decision
criteria.prohibited_inference: Gate passed is not release authorized.

criteria.title: Executive release authorization
criteria.permitted_disposition: Authorize, decline, or authorize with conditions.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Executive approval is not evidence substitution.

criteria.title: Deployment authorization
criteria.permitted_disposition: Authorize, hold, or authorize with rollback conditions.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Deployment authorized is not deployment executed.

criteria.title: Post-deployment stabilization acceptance
criteria.permitted_disposition: Accept, hold, or accept with obligations.
criteria.prohibited_inference: Deployment completed is not institutional outcome accepted.

authorities.title: Evidence owner
authorities.conflict_of_interest_treatment: May not review or accept its own evidence.
authorities.segregation_boundary: Separated from evidence review, acceptance, and release authority.

authorities.title: Evidence reviewer
authorities.conflict_of_interest_treatment: Recuses on owned or executed evidence.
authorities.delegation_rule: Delegable to a qualified peer reviewer.
authorities.segregation_boundary: Separated from evidence ownership, acceptance, and release authority.

authorities.title: Acceptance authority
authorities.required_independence: Independent of the evidence owner and reviewer.
authorities.segregation_boundary: Separated from evidence ownership, review, and release authority.

authorities.title: Release authority
authorities.authority_scope: Authorizes release of an accepted, gated candidate.
authorities.segregation_boundary: Separated from evidence ownership, review, and acceptance.

authorities.title: Independent assurance authority
authorities.required_independence: Independent of owner, reviewer, acceptance, and release authority.
authorities.segregation_boundary: Separated from all production and acceptance authorities.
